              ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>

              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) -

          ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                      (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *

import argparse
import json
import socket
from pathlib import Path


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="op", required=True)
    for op in ("check", "goals"):
        commands.add_parser(op).add_argument("file")
    commands.add_parser("status")
    commands.add_parser("finish").add_argument("--reason", required=True)
    search = commands.add_parser("search")
    search.add_argument("query")
    search.add_argument("--version")
    search.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=30)
    for op in ("read", "outline"):
        sub = commands.add_parser(op)
        sub.add_argument(
            "path", help="Lean source path, relative to the pinned project"
        )
        sub.add_argument("--version")
        if op == "read":
            sub.add_argument("--start", type=int, default=1)
            sub.add_argument("--end", type=int, default=180)
    args = vars(parser.parse_args())
    workspace = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    if args["op"] in ("check", "goals"):
        path = Path(args.pop("file"))
        if not path.is_absolute():
            path = workspace / path
        args["code"] = path.read_text()
    endpoint = json.loads((workspace / "tool_service.json").read_text())
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as client:
        # Individual Lean checks retain the evaluator's existing timeout.
        # Waiting for the host is not an optimization budget.
        client.connect(endpoint["socket"])
        client.sendall(json.dumps(args, ensure_ascii=False).encode() + b"\n")
        with client.makefile("rb") as stream:
            result = json.loads(stream.readline(4 * 1024 * 1024))
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
    if result.get("kind") == "tool_error":
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

6	module
7	
8	public import Physlib.QFT.PerturbationTheory.WickAlgebra.SuperCommute
9	public import Physlib.QFT.PerturbationTheory.FieldOpFreeAlgebra.TimeOrder
10	/-!
11	
12	# Time Ordering on Field operator algebra
13	
14	-/
15	
16	@[expose] public section
17	
18	namespace FieldSpecification
19	open Module FieldOpFreeAlgebra
20	open Physlib.List
21	open FieldStatistic
22	
23	namespace WickAlgebra
24	variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification}
25	
26	lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_eq_time_ofCrAnListF {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
27	    (φs1 φs2 : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (h :
28	      crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ3 ∧
29	      crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ3 ∧
30	      crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ2) :
31	    ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs1 * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF *
32	    ofCrAnListF φs2) = 0 := by
33	  calc _
34	      _ = ι (𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2))) -
35	          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ1, (ofList 𝓕.crAnStatistics [φ2, φ3])) •
36	          ι (𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ2 :: φ3 :: φ1 :: φs2))) -
37	          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ2, 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ3) •
38	          (ι (𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ3 :: φ2 :: φs2))) -
39	          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ1, ofList 𝓕.crAnStatistics [φ3, φ2]) •
40	          ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ3 :: φ2 :: φ1 :: φs2))) := by
41	        rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
42	        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
43	        simp only [List.singleton_append, ofList_singleton, map_sub, map_smul]
44	        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
45	        simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, ofList_singleton, mul_sub, ←
46	          ofCrAnListF_append, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul, List.append_assoc,
47	          Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
48	  let l1 :=
49	    (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 c)
50	    ((φs1 ++ φs2).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel))
51	    ++ (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ1) φs1)
52	  let l2 := (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ1) φs2)
53	    ++ (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ1)
54	    ((φs1 ++ φs2).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel))
55	  have h123 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2)) =
56	      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2)
57	      • (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ1, φ2, φ3]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
58	    have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φs1 [φ1, φ2, φ3] φs2
59	      (by simp_all)
60	    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2 = φs1 ++ [φ1, φ2, φ3] ++ φs2
61	      by simp, crAnTimeOrderList, h1]
62	    simp only [List.append_assoc, decide_not,
63	      Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
64	  have h132 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ3 :: φ2 :: φs2)) =
65	      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2)
66	      • (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ1, φ3, φ2]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
67	    have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φs1 [φ1, φ3, φ2] φs2
68	        (by simp_all)
69	    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ3 :: φ2 :: φs2 = φs1 ++ [φ1, φ3, φ2] ++ φs2
70	      by simp, crAnTimeOrderList, h1]
71	    simp only [decide_not,
72	      Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
73	    congr 1
74	    have hp : List.Perm [φ1, φ3, φ2] [φ1, φ2, φ3] := .cons φ1 (.swap φ2 φ3 [])
75	    rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_perm_eq _ _ φ1 _ _ _ _ _ hp, ← crAnTimeOrderSign]
76	    · simp
77	    · simp_all
78	  have hp231 : List.Perm [φ2, φ3, φ1] [φ1, φ2, φ3] :=
79	    ((List.Perm.swap φ1 φ3 []).cons φ2).trans (List.Perm.swap φ1 φ2 [φ3])
80	  have h231 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ2 :: φ3 :: φ1 :: φs2)) =
81	      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2)
82	      • (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ2, φ3, φ1]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
83	    have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φs1 [φ2, φ3, φ1] φs2
84	        (by simp_all)
85	    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs1 ++ φ2 :: φ3 :: φ1 :: φs2 = φs1 ++ [φ2, φ3, φ1] ++ φs2
86	      by simp, crAnTimeOrderList, h1]
87	    simp only [decide_not,
88	      Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
89	    congr 1
90	    rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_perm_eq _ _ φ1 _ _ _ _ _ hp231, ← crAnTimeOrderSign]
91	    · simp
92	    · simp_all
93	  have h321 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ3 :: φ2 :: φ1 :: φs2)) =
94	      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2)
95	      • (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ3, φ2, φ1]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
96	    have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φs1 [φ3, φ2, φ1] φs2
97	        (by simp_all)
98	    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs1 ++ φ3 :: φ2 :: φ1 :: φs2 = φs1 ++ [φ3, φ2, φ1] ++ φs2
99	      by simp, crAnTimeOrderList, h1]
100	    simp only [decide_not,
101	      Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
102	    congr 1
103	    have hp : List.Perm [φ3, φ2, φ1] [φ1, φ2, φ3] := (List.Perm.swap φ2 φ3 [φ1]).trans hp231
104	    rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_perm_eq _ _ φ1 _ _ _ _ _ hp, ← crAnTimeOrderSign]
105	    · simp
106	    · simp_all
107	  rw [h123, h132, h231, h321]
108	  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2) • (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) *
109	    ι [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF *
110	    ι (ofCrAnListF l2)); swap
111	  · simp
112	  rw [mul_assoc, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
113	    superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
114	  simp only [List.singleton_append, ofList_singleton, map_sub, map_smul]
115	  rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
116	  simp [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, ofList_singleton, map_sub,
117	    map_smul, mul_sub, sub_mul, Semigroup.mul_assoc]
118	  module
119	
120	lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
121	    (φs1 φs2 : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
122	    ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs1 * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs2)
123	    = 0 := by
124	  by_cases h :
125	      crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ3 ∧
126	      crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ3 ∧
127	      crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ2
128	  · exact ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_eq_time_ofCrAnListF φs1 φs2 h
129	  · rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid]
130	    simp [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_superCommuteF_all_not_crAnTimeOrderRel _ _ _ h]
131	
132	@[simp]
133	lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
134	    (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
135	    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF * b) = 0 := by
136	  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
137	    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF * b) = 0
138	  change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
139	  apply Submodule.span_induction
140	  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
141	    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, pb]
142	    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
143	      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) = 0
144	    change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
145	    apply Submodule.span_induction
146	    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
147	      simpa only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, pa] using
148	        ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF φs' φs
149	    · simp [pa]
150	    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
151	      simp_all [pa, add_mul]
152	    · intro x hx hpx
153	      simp_all [pa]
154	  · simp [pb]
155	  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
156	    simp_all [pb,mul_add]
157	  · intro x hx hpx
158	    simp_all [pb]
159	
160	example (c1 c2 : ℂ) (a : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) : c1 • c2 • a =
161	  c2 • c1 • a := smul_comm c1 c2 a
162	lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
163	    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
164	    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
165	    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
166	  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
167	    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
168	    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
169	  change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
170	  apply Submodule.span_induction
171	  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
172	    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pb]
173	    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
174	      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
175	      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a* ofCrAnListF φs))
176	    change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
177	    apply Submodule.span_induction
178	    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
179	      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pa]
180	      calc _
181	        /- Split the commutator. -/
182	        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
183	          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
184	            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
185	          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
186	            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
187	          conv_lhs =>
188	            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
189	              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
190	            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
191	            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
192	          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
193	          module
194	        /- Simplify the signs. -/
195	        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
196	          (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
197	          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
198	            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
199	          rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
200	          module
201	        /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
202	        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
203	          (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
204	                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
205	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
206	                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
207	              ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
208	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
209	                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
210	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
211	                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) -
212	          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
213	          ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
214	                      (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
215	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
216	                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
217	              ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) *
218	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
219	                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
220	              ι (ofCrAnListF
221	              (List.filter (fun c => decide (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
222	                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
223	          have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
224	            (by simp_all)
225	          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
226	          have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
227	            (by simp_all)
228	          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by simp, h2]
229	          repeat rw [ofCrAnListF_append]
230	          simp
231	        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
232	            (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
233	                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
234	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
235	                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
236	              (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
237	                ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) *
238	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
239	                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
240	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
241	                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
242	            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul]
243	        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
244	            (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
245	                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
246	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
247	                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
248	              ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
249	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
250	                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
251	              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
252	                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
253	            congr
254	            rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
255	              ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
256	            simp [← ofCrAnListF_append]
257	      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
258	      repeat rw [mul_assoc]
259	      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
260	        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
261	      have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
262	      simp [decide_not, Bool.decide_and, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] at h1 ⊢
263	      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
264	      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
265	      · simp [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]
266	      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by simp_all),
267	          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
268	        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
269	    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
270	    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
271	      simp_all [pa,mul_add, add_mul]
272	    · intro x hx hpx
273	      simp_all [pa]
274	  · simp only [map_mul, mul_zero, map_zero, pb]
275	  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
276	    simp_all [pb,mul_add]
277	  · intro x hx hpx
278	    simp_all [pb]
279	
280	lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
281	    (hφψ : ¬ (crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ)) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
282	    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) = 0 := by
283	  rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid]
284	  rcases Decidable.not_and_iff_or_not.mp hφψ with hφψ | hφψ
285	  · simp [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel hφψ]
286	  · rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_symm]
287	    simp [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel hφψ]
288	
289	/-!
290	
291	## Defining time order for `FiedOpAlgebra`.
292	
293	-/
294	
295	lemma ι_timeOrderF_zero_of_mem_ideal (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra)
296	    (h : a ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span 𝓕.fieldOpIdealSet) : ι 𝓣ᶠ(a) = 0 := by
297	  rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_span_iff_mem_addSubgroup_closure] at h
298	  let p {k : Set 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra} (a : FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕)
299	    (h : a ∈ AddSubgroup.closure k) := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a) = 0
300	  change p a h
301	  apply AddSubgroup.closure_induction
302	  · rintro x ⟨_, ⟨a, ha, c, hc, rfl⟩, b, hb, rfl⟩
303	    simp only [p]
304	    simp only [fieldOpIdealSet, exists_prop, exists_and_left, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hc
305	    rcases hc with ⟨φa, φa', hφa, hφa', rfl⟩ | ⟨φa, hφa, φb, hφb, rfl⟩ |
306	      ⟨φa, hφa, φb, hφb, rfl⟩ | ⟨φa, φb, hdiff, rfl⟩
307	    · simp
308	    · by_cases heqt : crAnTimeOrderRel φa φb ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φb φa
309	      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time heqt.1 heqt.2, map_mul,
310	          ι_superCommuteF_of_create_create _ _ hφa hφb, zero_mul]
311	      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time heqt]
312	    · by_cases heqt : crAnTimeOrderRel φa φb ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φb φa
313	      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time heqt.1 heqt.2, map_mul,
314	          ι_superCommuteF_of_annihilate_annihilate _ _ hφa hφb, zero_mul]
315	      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time heqt]
316	    · by_cases heqt : crAnTimeOrderRel φa φb ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φb φa
317	      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time heqt.1 heqt.2, map_mul,
318	          ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hdiff, zero_mul]
319	      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time heqt]
320	  · simp [p]
321	  · intro x y hx hy h1 h2
322	    simp_all [p]
323	  · intro x hx
324	    simp [p]
325	
326	lemma ι_timeOrderF_eq_of_equiv (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (h : a ≈ b) :
327	    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a) = ι 𝓣ᶠ(b) := by
328	  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, ← map_sub]
329	  exact ι_timeOrderF_zero_of_mem_ideal _ ((equiv_iff_sub_mem_ideal a b).mp h)
330	
331	/-- For a field specification `𝓕`, `timeOrder` is the linear map
332	
333	`WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕`
334	
335	defined as the descent of `ι ∘ₗ timeOrderF : FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕` from
336	`FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕` to `WickAlgebra 𝓕`.
337	This descent exists because `ι ∘ₗ timeOrderF` is well-defined on equivalence classes.
338	
339	The notation `𝓣(a)` is used for `timeOrder a`. -/
340	noncomputable def timeOrder : WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕 where
341	  toFun := Quotient.lift (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF) ι_timeOrderF_eq_of_equiv
342	  map_add' x y := by
343	    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ι_surjective x
344	    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ι_surjective y
345	    subst hx hy
346	    rw [← map_add, ι_apply, ι_apply, ι_apply]
347	    rw [Quotient.lift_mk, Quotient.lift_mk, Quotient.lift_mk]
348	    simp
349	  map_smul' c y := by
350	    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ι_surjective y
351	    subst hy
352	    rw [← map_smul, ι_apply, ι_apply]
353	    simp
354	
355	@[inherit_doc timeOrder]
356	scoped[FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra] notation "𝓣(" a ")" => timeOrder a
357	
358	/-!
359	
360	## Properties of time ordering
361	
362	-/
363	
364	lemma timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
365	    𝓣(ι a) = ι 𝓣ᶠ(a) := rfl
366	
367	lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
368	    𝓣(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ) = ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ := by
369	  rw [ofFieldOp, ofFieldOp, ← map_mul, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF,
370	    timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_ordered h]
371	
372	lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_not_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
373	    𝓣(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • ofFieldOp ψ * ofFieldOp φ := by
374	  rw [ofFieldOp, ofFieldOp, ← map_mul, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF,
375	    timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_not_ordered h]
376	  simp
377	
378	lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_not_ordered_eq_timeOrder {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp}
379	    (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
380	    𝓣(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • 𝓣(ofFieldOp ψ * ofFieldOp φ) := by
381	  rw [ofFieldOp, ofFieldOp, ← map_mul, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF,
382	    timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_not_ordered_eq_timeOrderF h, map_smul]
383	  rfl
384	
385	lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_nil : 𝓣(ofFieldOpList (𝓕 := 𝓕) []) = 1 := by
386	  rw [ofFieldOpList, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF_nil, map_one]
387	
388	@[simp]
389	lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_singleton (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
390	    𝓣(ofFieldOpList [φ]) = ofFieldOpList [φ] := by
391	  rw [ofFieldOpList, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF_singleton]
392	
393	/-- For a field specification `𝓕`, the time order operator acting on a
394	  list of `𝓕.FieldOp`, `𝓣(φ₀…φₙ)`, is equal to
395	  `𝓢(φᵢ,φ₀…φᵢ₋₁) • φᵢ * 𝓣(φ₀…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁φₙ)` where `φᵢ` is the maximal time field
396	  operator in `φ₀…φₙ`.
397	
398	  The proof of this result ultimately relies on basic properties of ordering and signs. -/
399	lemma timeOrder_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
400	    𝓣(ofFieldOpList (φ :: φs)) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ maxTimeField φ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).get,
401	      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x =>
402	        (maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs).succAbove x < maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs))⟩) •
403	      ofFieldOp (maxTimeField φ φs) * 𝓣(ofFieldOpList (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs)) := by
404	  rw [ofFieldOpList, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, timeOrderF_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset]
405	  rfl
406	
407	lemma timeOrder_superCommute_eq_time_mid {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
408	    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
409	    𝓣(a * [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * b) =
410	    [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * 𝓣(a * b) := by
411	  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ι_surjective a
412	  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ι_surjective b
413	  rw [ofCrAnOp, ofCrAnOp, superCommute_eq_ι_superCommuteF, ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
414	    timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
415	  rfl
416	
417	lemma timeOrder_superCommute_eq_time_left {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
418	    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
419	    𝓣([ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * b) =
420	    [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * 𝓣(b) := by
421	  simpa using timeOrder_superCommute_eq_time_mid hφψ hψφ 1 b
422	
423	lemma timeOrder_superCommute_ne_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
424	    (hφψ : ¬ (crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ)) :
425	    𝓣([ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ) = 0 := by
426	  rw [ofCrAnOp, ofCrAnOp, superCommute_eq_ι_superCommuteF, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF]
427	  simpa using ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time hφψ 1 1
428	
429	lemma timeOrder_superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOp_ne_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp}
430	    (hφψ : ¬ (timeOrderRel φ ψ ∧ timeOrderRel ψ φ)) :
431	    𝓣([anPart φ,ofFieldOp ψ]ₛ) = 0 := by
432	  rw [ofFieldOp_eq_sum]
433	  simp only [map_sum]
434	  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a ha => ?_
435	  match φ with
436	  | .inAsymp φ => simp
437	  | .position φ | .outAsymp φ =>
438	    simp only [anPart_position, anPart_outAsymp]
439	    apply timeOrder_superCommute_ne_time
440	    simp_all [crAnTimeOrderRel]
441	
442	/-- For a field specification `𝓕`, and `a`, `b`, `c` in `𝓕.WickAlgebra`, then
443	  `𝓣(a * b * c) = 𝓣(a * 𝓣(b) * c)`. -/
444	lemma timeOrder_timeOrder_mid (a b c : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
445	    𝓣(a * b * c) = 𝓣(a * 𝓣(b) * c) := by
446	  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ι_surjective a
447	  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ι_surjective b
448	  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ι_surjective c
449	  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF,
450	  ← map_mul, ← map_mul, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid]
451	
452	lemma timeOrder_timeOrder_left (b c : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
453	    𝓣(b * c) = 𝓣(𝓣(b) * c) := by
454	  simpa using timeOrder_timeOrder_mid 1 b c
455	
456	lemma timeOrder_timeOrder_right (a b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
457	    𝓣(a * b) = 𝓣(a * 𝓣(b)) := by
458	  simpa using timeOrder_timeOrder_mid a b 1
459	
460	/-- Time ordering is a projection. -/
461	lemma timeOrder_timeOrder (a : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
462	    𝓣(𝓣(a)) = 𝓣(a) := by
463	  simpa using (timeOrder_timeOrder_left a 1).symm
464	
465	end WickAlgebra
466	end FieldSpecification

module

public import Physlib.QFT.PerturbationTheory.WickAlgebra.SuperCommute
public import Physlib.QFT.PerturbationTheory.FieldOpFreeAlgebra.TimeOrder
/-!

# Time Ordering on Field operator algebra

-/

@[expose] public section

namespace FieldSpecification
open Module FieldOpFreeAlgebra
open Physlib.List
open FieldStatistic

namespace WickAlgebra
variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification}

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_eq_time_ofCrAnListF {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (φs1 φs2 : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (h :
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ3 ∧
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ3 ∧
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ2) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs1 * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF *
    ofCrAnListF φs2) = 0 := by
  calc _
      _ = ι (𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ1, (ofList 𝓕.crAnStatistics [φ2, φ3])) •
          ι (𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ2 :: φ3 :: φ1 :: φs2))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ2, 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ3) •
          (ι (𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ3 :: φ2 :: φs2))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ1, ofList 𝓕.crAnStatistics [φ3, φ2]) •
          ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ3 :: φ2 :: φ1 :: φs2))) := by
        rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [List.singleton_append, ofList_singleton, map_sub, map_smul]
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, ofList_singleton, mul_sub, ←
          ofCrAnListF_append, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul, List.append_assoc,
          Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
  let l1 :=
    (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 c)
    ((φs1 ++ φs2).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel))
    ++ (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ1) φs1)
  let l2 := (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ1) φs2)
    ++ (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ1)
    ((φs1 ++ φs2).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel))
  have h123 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2)) =
      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2)
      • (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ1, φ2, φ3]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
    have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φs1 [φ1, φ2, φ3] φs2
      (by simp_all)
    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2 = φs1 ++ [φ1, φ2, φ3] ++ φs2
      by simp, crAnTimeOrderList, h1]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, decide_not,
      Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
  have h132 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ3 :: φ2 :: φs2)) =
      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2)
      • (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ1, φ3, φ2]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
    have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φs1 [φ1, φ3, φ2] φs2
        (by simp_all)
    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ3 :: φ2 :: φs2 = φs1 ++ [φ1, φ3, φ2] ++ φs2
      by simp, crAnTimeOrderList, h1]
    simp only [decide_not,
      Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    have hp : List.Perm [φ1, φ3, φ2] [φ1, φ2, φ3] := .cons φ1 (.swap φ2 φ3 [])
    rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_perm_eq _ _ φ1 _ _ _ _ _ hp, ← crAnTimeOrderSign]
    · simp
    · simp_all
  have hp231 : List.Perm [φ2, φ3, φ1] [φ1, φ2, φ3] :=
    ((List.Perm.swap φ1 φ3 []).cons φ2).trans (List.Perm.swap φ1 φ2 [φ3])
  have h231 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ2 :: φ3 :: φ1 :: φs2)) =
      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2)
      • (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ2, φ3, φ1]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
    have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φs1 [φ2, φ3, φ1] φs2
        (by simp_all)
    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs1 ++ φ2 :: φ3 :: φ1 :: φs2 = φs1 ++ [φ2, φ3, φ1] ++ φs2
      by simp, crAnTimeOrderList, h1]
    simp only [decide_not,
      Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_perm_eq _ _ φ1 _ _ _ _ _ hp231, ← crAnTimeOrderSign]
    · simp
    · simp_all
  have h321 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs1 ++ φ3 :: φ2 :: φ1 :: φs2)) =
      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2)
      • (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ3, φ2, φ1]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
    have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φs1 [φ3, φ2, φ1] φs2
        (by simp_all)
    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs1 ++ φ3 :: φ2 :: φ1 :: φs2 = φs1 ++ [φ3, φ2, φ1] ++ φs2
      by simp, crAnTimeOrderList, h1]
    simp only [decide_not,
      Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    have hp : List.Perm [φ3, φ2, φ1] [φ1, φ2, φ3] := (List.Perm.swap φ2 φ3 [φ1]).trans hp231
    rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_perm_eq _ _ φ1 _ _ _ _ _ hp, ← crAnTimeOrderSign]
    · simp
    · simp_all
  rw [h123, h132, h231, h321]
  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs1 ++ φ1 :: φ2 :: φ3 :: φs2) • (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) *
    ι [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF *
    ι (ofCrAnListF l2)); swap
  · simp
  rw [mul_assoc, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
    superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
  simp only [List.singleton_append, ofList_singleton, map_sub, map_smul]
  rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
  simp [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, ofList_singleton, map_sub,
    map_smul, mul_sub, sub_mul, Semigroup.mul_assoc]
  module

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (φs1 φs2 : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs1 * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs2)
    = 0 := by
  by_cases h :
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ3 ∧
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ3 ∧
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ2
  · exact ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_eq_time_ofCrAnListF φs1 φs2 h
  · rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid]
    simp [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_superCommuteF_all_not_crAnTimeOrderRel _ _ _ h]

@[simp]
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF * b) = 0 := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF * b) = 0
  change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, pb]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) = 0
    change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simpa only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, pa] using
        ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF φs' φs
    · simp [pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp_all [pa, add_mul]
    · intro x hx hpx
      simp_all [pa]
  · simp [pb]
  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
    simp_all [pb,mul_add]
  · intro x hx hpx
    simp_all [pb]

example (c1 c2 : ℂ) (a : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) : c1 • c2 • a =
  c2 • c1 • a := smul_comm c1 c2 a
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pb]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a* ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pa]
      calc _
        /- Split the commutator. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
          module
        /- Simplify the signs. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
          rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          module
        /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                      (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF
              (List.filter (fun c => decide (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
          have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
            (by simp_all)
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
          have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
            (by simp_all)
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by simp, h2]
          repeat rw [ofCrAnListF_append]
          simp
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
                ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
            congr
            rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
            simp [← ofCrAnListF_append]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      repeat rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
      simp [decide_not, Bool.decide_and, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] at h1 ⊢
      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by simp_all),
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp_all [pa,mul_add, add_mul]
    · intro x hx hpx
      simp_all [pa]
  · simp only [map_mul, mul_zero, map_zero, pb]
  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
    simp_all [pb,mul_add]
  · intro x hx hpx
    simp_all [pb]

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : ¬ (crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ)) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) = 0 := by
  rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid]
  rcases Decidable.not_and_iff_or_not.mp hφψ with hφψ | hφψ
  · simp [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel hφψ]
  · rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_symm]
    simp [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel hφψ]

/-!

## Defining time order for `FiedOpAlgebra`.

-/

lemma ι_timeOrderF_zero_of_mem_ideal (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra)
    (h : a ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span 𝓕.fieldOpIdealSet) : ι 𝓣ᶠ(a) = 0 := by
  rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_span_iff_mem_addSubgroup_closure] at h
  let p {k : Set 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra} (a : FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕)
    (h : a ∈ AddSubgroup.closure k) := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a) = 0
  change p a h
  apply AddSubgroup.closure_induction
  · rintro x ⟨_, ⟨a, ha, c, hc, rfl⟩, b, hb, rfl⟩
    simp only [p]
    simp only [fieldOpIdealSet, exists_prop, exists_and_left, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hc
    rcases hc with ⟨φa, φa', hφa, hφa', rfl⟩ | ⟨φa, hφa, φb, hφb, rfl⟩ |
      ⟨φa, hφa, φb, hφb, rfl⟩ | ⟨φa, φb, hdiff, rfl⟩
    · simp
    · by_cases heqt : crAnTimeOrderRel φa φb ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φb φa
      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time heqt.1 heqt.2, map_mul,
          ι_superCommuteF_of_create_create _ _ hφa hφb, zero_mul]
      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time heqt]
    · by_cases heqt : crAnTimeOrderRel φa φb ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φb φa
      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time heqt.1 heqt.2, map_mul,
          ι_superCommuteF_of_annihilate_annihilate _ _ hφa hφb, zero_mul]
      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time heqt]
    · by_cases heqt : crAnTimeOrderRel φa φb ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φb φa
      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time heqt.1 heqt.2, map_mul,
          ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hdiff, zero_mul]
      · rw [ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time heqt]
  · simp [p]
  · intro x y hx hy h1 h2
    simp_all [p]
  · intro x hx
    simp [p]

lemma ι_timeOrderF_eq_of_equiv (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (h : a ≈ b) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a) = ι 𝓣ᶠ(b) := by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, ← map_sub]
  exact ι_timeOrderF_zero_of_mem_ideal _ ((equiv_iff_sub_mem_ideal a b).mp h)

/-- For a field specification `𝓕`, `timeOrder` is the linear map

`WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕`

defined as the descent of `ι ∘ₗ timeOrderF : FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕` from
`FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕` to `WickAlgebra 𝓕`.
This descent exists because `ι ∘ₗ timeOrderF` is well-defined on equivalence classes.

The notation `𝓣(a)` is used for `timeOrder a`. -/
noncomputable def timeOrder : WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕 where
  toFun := Quotient.lift (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF) ι_timeOrderF_eq_of_equiv
  map_add' x y := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ι_surjective x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ι_surjective y
    subst hx hy
    rw [← map_add, ι_apply, ι_apply, ι_apply]
    rw [Quotient.lift_mk, Quotient.lift_mk, Quotient.lift_mk]
    simp
  map_smul' c y := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ι_surjective y
    subst hy
    rw [← map_smul, ι_apply, ι_apply]
    simp

@[inherit_doc timeOrder]
scoped[FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra] notation "𝓣(" a ")" => timeOrder a

/-!

## Properties of time ordering

-/

lemma timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    𝓣(ι a) = ι 𝓣ᶠ(a) := rfl

lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ) = ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ := by
  rw [ofFieldOp, ofFieldOp, ← map_mul, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF,
    timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_ordered h]

lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_not_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • ofFieldOp ψ * ofFieldOp φ := by
  rw [ofFieldOp, ofFieldOp, ← map_mul, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF,
    timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_not_ordered h]
  simp

lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_not_ordered_eq_timeOrder {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • 𝓣(ofFieldOp ψ * ofFieldOp φ) := by
  rw [ofFieldOp, ofFieldOp, ← map_mul, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF,
    timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_not_ordered_eq_timeOrderF h, map_smul]
  rfl

lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_nil : 𝓣(ofFieldOpList (𝓕 := 𝓕) []) = 1 := by
  rw [ofFieldOpList, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF_nil, map_one]

@[simp]
lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_singleton (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOpList [φ]) = ofFieldOpList [φ] := by
  rw [ofFieldOpList, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF_singleton]

/-- For a field specification `𝓕`, the time order operator acting on a
  list of `𝓕.FieldOp`, `𝓣(φ₀…φₙ)`, is equal to
  `𝓢(φᵢ,φ₀…φᵢ₋₁) • φᵢ * 𝓣(φ₀…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁φₙ)` where `φᵢ` is the maximal time field
  operator in `φ₀…φₙ`.

  The proof of this result ultimately relies on basic properties of ordering and signs. -/
lemma timeOrder_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOpList (φ :: φs)) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ maxTimeField φ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).get,
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x =>
        (maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs).succAbove x < maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs))⟩) •
      ofFieldOp (maxTimeField φ φs) * 𝓣(ofFieldOpList (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs)) := by
  rw [ofFieldOpList, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, timeOrderF_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset]
  rfl

lemma timeOrder_superCommute_eq_time_mid {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(a * [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * b) =
    [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * 𝓣(a * b) := by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ι_surjective a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ι_surjective b
  rw [ofCrAnOp, ofCrAnOp, superCommute_eq_ι_superCommuteF, ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
    timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
  rfl

lemma timeOrder_superCommute_eq_time_left {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣([ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * b) =
    [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * 𝓣(b) := by
  simpa using timeOrder_superCommute_eq_time_mid hφψ hψφ 1 b

lemma timeOrder_superCommute_ne_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : ¬ (crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ)) :
    𝓣([ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ) = 0 := by
  rw [ofCrAnOp, ofCrAnOp, superCommute_eq_ι_superCommuteF, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF]
  simpa using ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time hφψ 1 1

lemma timeOrder_superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOp_ne_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (hφψ : ¬ (timeOrderRel φ ψ ∧ timeOrderRel ψ φ)) :
    𝓣([anPart φ,ofFieldOp ψ]ₛ) = 0 := by
  rw [ofFieldOp_eq_sum]
  simp only [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a ha => ?_
  match φ with
  | .inAsymp φ => simp
  | .position φ | .outAsymp φ =>
    simp only [anPart_position, anPart_outAsymp]
    apply timeOrder_superCommute_ne_time
    simp_all [crAnTimeOrderRel]

/-- For a field specification `𝓕`, and `a`, `b`, `c` in `𝓕.WickAlgebra`, then
  `𝓣(a * b * c) = 𝓣(a * 𝓣(b) * c)`. -/
lemma timeOrder_timeOrder_mid (a b c : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(a * b * c) = 𝓣(a * 𝓣(b) * c) := by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ι_surjective a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ι_surjective b
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ι_surjective c
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF,
  ← map_mul, ← map_mul, timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF, timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid]

lemma timeOrder_timeOrder_left (b c : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(b * c) = 𝓣(𝓣(b) * c) := by
  simpa using timeOrder_timeOrder_mid 1 b c

lemma timeOrder_timeOrder_right (a b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(a * b) = 𝓣(a * 𝓣(b)) := by
  simpa using timeOrder_timeOrder_mid a b 1

/-- Time ordering is a projection. -/
lemma timeOrder_timeOrder (a : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(𝓣(a)) = 𝓣(a) := by
  simpa using (timeOrder_timeOrder_left a 1).symm

end WickAlgebra
end FieldSpecification

1	/-

3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
4	Authors: Joseph Tooby-Smith
5	-/
6	module
7	
8	public import Physlib.QFT.PerturbationTheory.FieldSpecification.TimeOrder
9	public import Physlib.QFT.PerturbationTheory.FieldOpFreeAlgebra.SuperCommute
10	/-!
11	
12	# Time Ordering in the FieldOpFreeAlgebra
13	
14	-/
15	
16	@[expose] public section
17	
18	namespace FieldSpecification
19	variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification}
20	open Module FieldStatistic
21	
22	namespace FieldOpFreeAlgebra
23	
24	noncomputable section
25	open Physlib.List
26	/-!
27	
28	## Time order
29	
30	-/
31	
32	/-- For a field specification `𝓕`, `timeOrderF` is the linear map
33	
34	  `FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕`
35	
36	  defined by its action on the basis `ofCrAnListF φs`, taking
37	  `ofCrAnListF φs` to
38	
39	  `crAnTimeOrderSign φs • ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList φs)`.
40	
41	  That is, `timeOrderF` time-orders the field operators and multiplies by the sign of the
42	  time order.
43	
44	  The notation `𝓣ᶠ(a)` is used for `timeOrderF a` -/
45	def timeOrderF : FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕 :=
46	  Basis.constr ofCrAnListFBasis ℂ fun φs =>
47	  crAnTimeOrderSign φs • ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList φs)
48	
49	@[inherit_doc timeOrderF]
50	scoped[FieldSpecification.FieldOpFreeAlgebra] notation "𝓣ᶠ(" a ")" => timeOrderF a
51	
52	lemma timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
53	    𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs) = crAnTimeOrderSign φs • ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList φs) := by
54	  rw [← ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
55	  simp only [timeOrderF, Basis.constr_basis]
56	
57	lemma timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid (a b c : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
58	    𝓣ᶠ(a * b * c) = 𝓣ᶠ(a * 𝓣ᶠ(b) * c) := by
59	  let pc (c : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : c ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
60	    Prop := 𝓣ᶠ(a * b * c) = 𝓣ᶠ(a * 𝓣ᶠ(b) * c)
61	  change pc c (Basis.mem_span _ c)
62	  apply Submodule.span_induction
63	  · intro x hx
64	    obtain ⟨φs, rfl⟩ := hx
65	    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, pc]
66	    let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hb : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
67	      Prop := 𝓣ᶠ(a * b * ofCrAnListF φs) = 𝓣ᶠ(a * 𝓣ᶠ(b) * ofCrAnListF φs)
68	    change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
69	    apply Submodule.span_induction
70	    · intro x hx
71	      obtain ⟨φs', rfl⟩ := hx
72	      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, pb]
73	      let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (ha : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
74	        Prop := 𝓣ᶠ(a * ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs) =
75	          𝓣ᶠ(a * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs') * ofCrAnListF φs)
76	      change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
77	      apply Submodule.span_induction
78	      · intro x hx
79	        obtain ⟨φs'', rfl⟩ := hx
80	        simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, pa]
81	        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
82	        simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, Algebra.mul_smul_comm,
83	          Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul]
84	        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, smul_smul]
85	        congr 1
86	        · simp only [crAnTimeOrderSign, crAnTimeOrderList]
87	          rw [Wick.koszulSign_of_append_eq_insertionSort, mul_comm]
88	        · congr 1
89	          simp only [crAnTimeOrderList]
90	          rw [insertionSort_append_insertionSort_append]
91	      · simp [pa]
92	      · intro x y hx hy h1 h2
93	        simp_all [pa, add_mul]
94	      · intro x hx h
95	        simp_all [pa]
96	    · simp [pb]
97	    · intro x y hx hy h1 h2
98	      simp_all [pb, mul_add, add_mul]
99	    · intro x hx h
100	      simp_all [pb]
101	  · simp [pc]
102	  · intro x y hx hy h1 h2
103	    simp_all [pc, mul_add]
104	  · intro x hx h hp
105	    simp_all [pc]
106	
107	lemma timeOrderF_timeOrderF_right (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) : 𝓣ᶠ(a * b) = 𝓣ᶠ(a * 𝓣ᶠ(b)) := by
108	  trans 𝓣ᶠ(a * b * 1)
109	  · simp
110	  · rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid]
111	    simp
112	
113	lemma timeOrderF_timeOrderF_left (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) : 𝓣ᶠ(a * b) = 𝓣ᶠ(𝓣ᶠ(a) * b) := by
114	  trans 𝓣ᶠ(1 * a * b)
115	  · simp
116	  · rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid]
117	    simp
118	
119	lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
120	    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpListF φs) = timeOrderSign φs • ofFieldOpListF (timeOrderList φs) := by
121	  conv_lhs =>
122	    rw [ofFieldOpListF_sum, map_sum]
123	    enter [2, x]
124	    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
125	  simp only [crAnTimeOrderSign_crAnSection]
126	  rw [← Finset.smul_sum]
127	  congr
128	  rw [ofFieldOpListF_sum, sum_crAnSections_timeOrder]
129	  rfl
130	
131	lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF_nil : timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕) (ofFieldOpListF []) = 1 := by
132	  rw [timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF]
133	  simp [timeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign, timeOrderList]
134	
135	@[simp]
136	lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF_singleton (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
137	    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpListF [φ]) = ofFieldOpListF [φ] := by
138	  simp [timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF, timeOrderSign, timeOrderList]
139	
140	lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
141	    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpF φ * ofFieldOpF ψ) = ofFieldOpF φ * ofFieldOpF ψ := by
142	  rw [← ofFieldOpListF_singleton, ← ofFieldOpListF_singleton, ← ofFieldOpListF_append,
143	    timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF]
144	  simp only [List.singleton_append]
145	  rw [timeOrderSign_pair_ordered h, timeOrderList_pair_ordered h]
146	  simp
147	
148	lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_not_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
149	    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpF φ * ofFieldOpF ψ) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • ofFieldOpF ψ * ofFieldOpF φ := by
150	  rw [← ofFieldOpListF_singleton, ← ofFieldOpListF_singleton,
151	    ← ofFieldOpListF_append, timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF]
152	  simp only [List.singleton_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
153	  rw [timeOrderSign_pair_not_ordered h, timeOrderList_pair_not_ordered h]
154	  simp [← ofFieldOpListF_append]
155	
156	lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_not_ordered_eq_timeOrderF {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp}
157	    (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
158	    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpF φ * ofFieldOpF ψ) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • 𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpF ψ * ofFieldOpF φ) := by
159	  rw [timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_not_ordered h]
160	  rw [timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_ordered]
161	  simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
162	  have hx := Std.Total.total (r := timeOrderRel) ψ φ
163	  simp_all
164	
165	lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel
166	    {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) :
167	    𝓣ᶠ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF) = 0 := by
168	  rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
169	  simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
170	  rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
171	    ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
172	  simp only [List.singleton_append]
173	  rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_pair_not_ordered h, crAnTimeOrderList_pair_not_ordered h]
174	  rw [sub_eq_zero, smul_smul]
175	  have h1 := Std.Total.total (r := crAnTimeOrderRel) φ ψ
176	  congr
177	  · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_pair_ordered, exchangeSign_symm]
178	    simp only [mul_one]
179	    simp_all
180	  · rw [crAnTimeOrderList_pair_ordered]
181	    simp_all
182	
183	lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_right
184	    {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
185	    𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF) = 0 := by
186	  rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_right,
187	    timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h]
188	  simp
189	
190	lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_left
191	    {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
192	    𝓣ᶠ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * a) = 0 := by
193	  rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_left,
194	    timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h]
195	  simp
196	
197	lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_mid
198	    {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
199	    𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) = 0 := by
200	  rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid,
201	    timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h]
202	  simp
203	
204	lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel
205	    {φ1 φ2 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2) (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
206	    𝓣ᶠ([a, [ofCrAnOpF φ1, ofCrAnOpF φ2]ₛF]ₛF) = 0 := by
207	  rw [← bosonicProjF_add_fermionicProjF a]
208	  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
209	  rw [bosonic_superCommuteF (Submodule.coe_mem (bosonicProjF a))]
210	  simp only [map_sub]
211	  rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_left h]
212	  rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_right h]
213	  simp only [sub_self, zero_add]
214	  rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
215	  rcases superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF_bosonic_or_fermionic [φ1] [φ2] with h' | h'
216	  · rw [superCommuteF_bonsonic h']
217	    simp only [ofCrAnListF_singleton, map_sub]
218	    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_left h]
219	    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_right h]
220	    simp
221	  · rw [superCommuteF_fermionic_fermionic (Submodule.coe_mem (fermionicProjF a)) h']
222	    simp only [ofCrAnListF_singleton, map_add]
223	    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_left h]
224	    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_right h]
225	    simp
226	
227	lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_superCommuteF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel
228	    {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h12 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2)
229	    (h13 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ3) :
230	    𝓣ᶠ([ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF) = 0 := by
231	  rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
232	  rw [summerCommute_jacobi_ofCrAnListF]
233	  simp only [ofList_singleton, ofCrAnListF_singleton, neg_smul, map_smul,
234	    map_sub, map_neg, smul_eq_zero]
235	  right
236	  rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h12]
237	  rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_symm φ3]
238	  simp only [smul_zero, neg_zero, neg_smul, map_neg, map_smul, smul_neg,
239	    sub_neg_eq_add, zero_add, smul_eq_zero]
240	  rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h13]
241	  simp
242	
243	lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_superCommuteF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel'
244	    {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h12 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ1)
245	    (h13 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ1) :
246	    𝓣ᶠ([ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF) = 0 := by
247	  rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
248	  rw [summerCommute_jacobi_ofCrAnListF]
249	  simp only [ofList_singleton, ofCrAnListF_singleton, neg_smul, map_smul,
250	    map_sub, map_neg, smul_eq_zero]
251	  right
252	  rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_symm φ1]
253	  simp only [neg_smul, map_neg, map_smul, smul_neg, neg_neg]
254	  rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h12]
255	  simp only [smul_zero, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero, smul_eq_zero]
256	  rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h13]
257	  simp
258	
259	lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_superCommuteF_all_not_crAnTimeOrderRel
260	    (φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (h : ¬
261	      (crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ3 ∧
262	      crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ3 ∧
263	      crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ2)) :
264	    𝓣ᶠ([ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF) = 0 := by
265	  simp only [not_and] at h
266	  by_cases h23 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ3
267	  · simp_all only [IsEmpty.forall_iff, implies_true]
268	    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h23]
269	  simp_all only [Decidable.not_not, forall_const]
270	  by_cases h32 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ2
271	  · simp_all only [not_false_eq_true, implies_true]
272	    rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_symm]
273	    simp only [neg_smul, map_neg, map_smul, neg_eq_zero, smul_eq_zero]
274	    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h32]
275	    simp
276	  simp_all only [imp_false, Decidable.not_not]
277	  by_cases h12 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2
278	  · have h13 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ3 := by
279	      intro h13
280	      apply h12
281	      exact IsTrans.trans φ1 φ3 φ2 h13 h32
282	    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_superCommuteF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h12 h13]
283	  simp_all only [Decidable.not_not, forall_const]
284	  have h13 : crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ3 := IsTrans.trans φ1 φ2 φ3 h12 h23
285	  simp_all only [forall_const]
286	  by_cases h21 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ1
287	  · simp_all only [IsEmpty.forall_iff]
288	    have h31 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ1 := by
289	      intro h31
290	      apply h21
291	      exact IsTrans.trans φ2 φ3 φ1 h23 h31
292	    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_superCommuteF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel' h21 h31]
293	  simp_all only [Decidable.not_not, forall_const]
294	  refine False.elim (h ?_)
295	  exact IsTrans.trans φ3 φ2 φ1 h32 h21
296	
297	lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_eq_time
298	    {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h1 : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (h2 : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) :
299	    𝓣ᶠ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF) = [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF := by
300	  rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
301	  simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
302	  rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
303	    ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
304	  simp only [List.singleton_append]
305	  rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_pair_ordered h1, crAnTimeOrderList_pair_ordered h1,
306	    crAnTimeOrderSign_pair_ordered h2, crAnTimeOrderList_pair_ordered h2]
307	  simp
308	
309	/-!
310	
311	## Interaction with maxTimeField
312	
313	-/
314	
315	/-- In the state algebra time, ordering obeys `T(φ₀φ₁…φₙ) = s * φᵢ * T(φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁…φₙ)`
316	  where `φᵢ` is the state
317	  which has maximum time and `s` is the exchange sign of `φᵢ` and `φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁`. -/
318	lemma timeOrderF_eq_maxTimeField_mul (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
319	    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpListF (φ :: φs)) =
320	    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ maxTimeField φ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ (φ :: φs).take (maxTimeFieldPos φ φs)) •
321	    ofFieldOpF (maxTimeField φ φs) * 𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpListF (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs)) := by
322	  rw [timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF, timeOrderList_eq_maxTimeField_timeOrderList]
323	  rw [ofFieldOpListF_cons, timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF]
324	  simp only [Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
325	  congr
326	  rw [timerOrderSign_of_eraseMaxTimeField, mul_assoc]
327	  simp
328	
329	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
330	/-- In the state algebra time, ordering obeys `T(φ₀φ₁…φₙ) = s * φᵢ * T(φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁…φₙ)`
331	  where `φᵢ` is the state
332	  which has maximum time and `s` is the exchange sign of `φᵢ` and `φ₀φ₁…φᵢ₋₁`.
333	  Here `s` is written using finite sets. -/
334	lemma timeOrderF_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
335	    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpListF (φ :: φs)) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ maxTimeField φ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).get,
336	      (Finset.filter (fun x =>
337	        (maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs).succAbove x < maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs) Finset.univ)⟩) •
338	      ofFieldOpF (maxTimeField φ φs) * 𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpListF (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs)) := by
339	  rw [timeOrderF_eq_maxTimeField_mul]
340	  congr 3
341	  apply FieldStatistic.ofList_perm
342	  nth_rewrite 1 [← List.map_get_finRange (φ :: φs)]
343	  simp only [List.length_cons, eraseMaxTimeField, insertionSortDropMinPos]
344	  rw [eraseIdx_get, ← List.map_take, ← List.map_map]
345	  refine List.Perm.map (φ :: φs).get ?_
346	  apply (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup _ _).mpr
347	  · intro i
348	    simp only [List.length_cons, maxTimeFieldPos, mem_take_finrange, Fin.val_fin_lt, List.mem_map,
349	      Finset.mem_sort, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Function.comp_apply]
350	    refine Iff.intro (fun hi => ?_) (fun h => ?_)
351	    · have h2 := (maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs).2
352	      simp only [eraseMaxTimeField, insertionSortDropMinPos, List.length_cons, Nat.succ_eq_add_one,
353	        maxTimeFieldPosFin, insertionSortMinPosFin] at h2
354	      use ⟨i, by omega⟩
355	      apply And.intro
356	      · simp only [Fin.succAbove, List.length_cons, Fin.castSucc_mk, maxTimeFieldPosFin,
357	        insertionSortMinPosFin, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.mk_lt_mk, Fin.val_fin_lt, Fin.succ_mk]
358	        rw [Fin.lt_def]
359	        split
360	        · simp only [Fin.val_fin_lt]
361	          omega
362	        · omega
363	      · simp only [Fin.succAbove, List.length_cons, Fin.castSucc_mk, Fin.succ_mk, Fin.ext_iff,
364	        Fin.val_cast]
365	        split
366	        · simp
367	        · simp_all [Fin.lt_def]
368	    · obtain ⟨j, h1, h2⟩ := h
369	      subst h2
370	      simp only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_cast]
371	      exact h1
372	  · exact List.Sublist.nodup (List.take_sublist _ _) <|
373	      List.nodup_finRange (φs.length + 1)
374	  · refine List.Nodup.map ?_ ?_
375	    · refine Function.Injective.comp ?hf.hg Fin.succAbove_right_injective
376	      exact Fin.cast_injective (eraseIdx_length (φ :: φs) (insertionSortMinPos timeOrderRel φ φs))
377	    · exact Finset.sort_nodup
378	        (Finset.filter (fun x => (maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs).succAbove x < maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs)
379	          Finset.univ) (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2)
380	
381	end
382	
383	end FieldOpFreeAlgebra
384	
385	end FieldSpecification

module

public import Physlib.QFT.PerturbationTheory.FieldSpecification.TimeOrder
public import Physlib.QFT.PerturbationTheory.FieldOpFreeAlgebra.SuperCommute
/-!

# Time Ordering in the FieldOpFreeAlgebra

-/

@[expose] public section

namespace FieldSpecification
variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification}
open Module FieldStatistic

namespace FieldOpFreeAlgebra

noncomputable section
open Physlib.List
/-!

## Time order

-/

/-- For a field specification `𝓕`, `timeOrderF` is the linear map

  `FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕`

  defined by its action on the basis `ofCrAnListF φs`, taking
  `ofCrAnListF φs` to

  `crAnTimeOrderSign φs • ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList φs)`.

  That is, `timeOrderF` time-orders the field operators and multiplies by the sign of the
  time order.

  The notation `𝓣ᶠ(a)` is used for `timeOrderF a` -/
def timeOrderF : FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕 :=
  Basis.constr ofCrAnListFBasis ℂ fun φs =>
  crAnTimeOrderSign φs • ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList φs)

@[inherit_doc timeOrderF]
scoped[FieldSpecification.FieldOpFreeAlgebra] notation "𝓣ᶠ(" a ")" => timeOrderF a

lemma timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs) = crAnTimeOrderSign φs • ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList φs) := by
  rw [← ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  simp only [timeOrderF, Basis.constr_basis]

lemma timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid (a b c : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    𝓣ᶠ(a * b * c) = 𝓣ᶠ(a * 𝓣ᶠ(b) * c) := by
  let pc (c : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : c ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := 𝓣ᶠ(a * b * c) = 𝓣ᶠ(a * 𝓣ᶠ(b) * c)
  change pc c (Basis.mem_span _ c)
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨φs, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, pc]
    let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hb : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := 𝓣ᶠ(a * b * ofCrAnListF φs) = 𝓣ᶠ(a * 𝓣ᶠ(b) * ofCrAnListF φs)
    change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨φs', rfl⟩ := hx
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, pb]
      let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (ha : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
        Prop := 𝓣ᶠ(a * ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs) =
          𝓣ᶠ(a * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs') * ofCrAnListF φs)
      change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
      apply Submodule.span_induction
      · intro x hx
        obtain ⟨φs'', rfl⟩ := hx
        simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, pa]
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, Algebra.mul_smul_comm,
          Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul]
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, smul_smul]
        congr 1
        · simp only [crAnTimeOrderSign, crAnTimeOrderList]
          rw [Wick.koszulSign_of_append_eq_insertionSort, mul_comm]
        · congr 1
          simp only [crAnTimeOrderList]
          rw [insertionSort_append_insertionSort_append]
      · simp [pa]
      · intro x y hx hy h1 h2
        simp_all [pa, add_mul]
      · intro x hx h
        simp_all [pa]
    · simp [pb]
    · intro x y hx hy h1 h2
      simp_all [pb, mul_add, add_mul]
    · intro x hx h
      simp_all [pb]
  · simp [pc]
  · intro x y hx hy h1 h2
    simp_all [pc, mul_add]
  · intro x hx h hp
    simp_all [pc]

lemma timeOrderF_timeOrderF_right (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) : 𝓣ᶠ(a * b) = 𝓣ᶠ(a * 𝓣ᶠ(b)) := by
  trans 𝓣ᶠ(a * b * 1)
  · simp
  · rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid]
    simp

lemma timeOrderF_timeOrderF_left (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) : 𝓣ᶠ(a * b) = 𝓣ᶠ(𝓣ᶠ(a) * b) := by
  trans 𝓣ᶠ(1 * a * b)
  · simp
  · rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid]
    simp

lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpListF φs) = timeOrderSign φs • ofFieldOpListF (timeOrderList φs) := by
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [ofFieldOpListF_sum, map_sum]
    enter [2, x]
    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
  simp only [crAnTimeOrderSign_crAnSection]
  rw [← Finset.smul_sum]
  congr
  rw [ofFieldOpListF_sum, sum_crAnSections_timeOrder]
  rfl

lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF_nil : timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕) (ofFieldOpListF []) = 1 := by
  rw [timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF]
  simp [timeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign, timeOrderList]

@[simp]
lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF_singleton (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpListF [φ]) = ofFieldOpListF [φ] := by
  simp [timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF, timeOrderSign, timeOrderList]

lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpF φ * ofFieldOpF ψ) = ofFieldOpF φ * ofFieldOpF ψ := by
  rw [← ofFieldOpListF_singleton, ← ofFieldOpListF_singleton, ← ofFieldOpListF_append,
    timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF]
  simp only [List.singleton_append]
  rw [timeOrderSign_pair_ordered h, timeOrderList_pair_ordered h]
  simp

lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_not_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpF φ * ofFieldOpF ψ) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • ofFieldOpF ψ * ofFieldOpF φ := by
  rw [← ofFieldOpListF_singleton, ← ofFieldOpListF_singleton,
    ← ofFieldOpListF_append, timeOrderF_ofFieldOpListF]
  simp only [List.singleton_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [timeOrderSign_pair_not_ordered h, timeOrderList_pair_not_ordered h]
  simp [← ofFieldOpListF_append]

lemma timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_not_ordered_eq_timeOrderF {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpF φ * ofFieldOpF ψ) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • 𝓣ᶠ(ofFieldOpF ψ * ofFieldOpF φ) := by
  rw [timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_not_ordered h]
  rw [timeOrderF_ofFieldOpF_ofFieldOpF_ordered]
  simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
  have hx := Std.Total.total (r := timeOrderRel) ψ φ
  simp_all

lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel
    {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    𝓣ᶠ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF) = 0 := by
  rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
  simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
  rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
    ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
  simp only [List.singleton_append]
  rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_pair_not_ordered h, crAnTimeOrderList_pair_not_ordered h]
  rw [sub_eq_zero, smul_smul]
  have h1 := Std.Total.total (r := crAnTimeOrderRel) φ ψ
  congr
  · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_pair_ordered, exchangeSign_symm]
    simp only [mul_one]
    simp_all
  · rw [crAnTimeOrderList_pair_ordered]
    simp_all

lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_right
    {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF) = 0 := by
  rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_right,
    timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h]
  simp

lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_left
    {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    𝓣ᶠ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * a) = 0 := by
  rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_left,
    timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h]
  simp

lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_mid
    {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) = 0 := by
  rw [timeOrderF_timeOrderF_mid,
    timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h]
  simp

lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel
    {φ1 φ2 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2) (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    𝓣ᶠ([a, [ofCrAnOpF φ1, ofCrAnOpF φ2]ₛF]ₛF) = 0 := by
  rw [← bosonicProjF_add_fermionicProjF a]
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  rw [bosonic_superCommuteF (Submodule.coe_mem (bosonicProjF a))]
  simp only [map_sub]
  rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_left h]
  rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_right h]
  simp only [sub_self, zero_add]
  rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
  rcases superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF_bosonic_or_fermionic [φ1] [φ2] with h' | h'
  · rw [superCommuteF_bonsonic h']
    simp only [ofCrAnListF_singleton, map_sub]
    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_left h]
    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_right h]
    simp
  · rw [superCommuteF_fermionic_fermionic (Submodule.coe_mem (fermionicProjF a)) h']
    simp only [ofCrAnListF_singleton, map_add]
    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_left h]
    rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel_right h]
    simp

lemma timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_superCommuteF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel
    {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h12 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2)
    (h13 : ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ3) :
    𝓣ᶠ([ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF) = 0 := by
  rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
  rw [summerCommute_jacobi_ofCrAnListF]
  simp only [ofList_singleton, ofCrAnListF_singleton, neg_smul, map_smul,
    map_sub, map_neg, smul_eq_zero]
  right
  rw [timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_not_crAnTimeOrderRel h12]
